result:
I’d make it impossible to experience another person as less real than yourself.

Not forced agreement. Not automatic kindness. Just the end of that mental trick where someone else’s fear, grief, or humiliation becomes distant and abstract, while your own feels absolute.

You could still disagree, oppose, even fight. But you couldn’t do it from the comforting fiction that their inner life matters less than yours.

I suspect an extraordinary amount of cruelty begins with that fiction.
